query:
SELECT 
  id,
  client_email,
  client_name,
  vessel_id,
  vessel_name,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(booking_date/1000) as booking_date_formatted,
  booking_date,
  status,
  notes,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM bookings
WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(booking_date/1000) >= '2026-01-30 00:00:00'
  AND FROM_UNIXTIME(booking_date/1000) < '2026-01-31 00:00:00'
ORDER BY booking_date;
